title: Null control: drone crossref share vs DAL
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: gdelt.gkg.drone_share 20d z-score > 1 should NOT predict DAL selloffs; if short DAL 2d at 2d lag also scores, drone-share is a war proxy not an airspace signal (-) [gdelt.gkg.drone_share -> finance.DAL.log_return] (parent: R2-0063)
message: Null control holds: gdelt drone_share z>1 does not predict DAL selloffs (r=-0.025, n=390, perm_p=0.73, validity 0, hit 0.50); crossref drone cache absent so gdelt.gkg.drone_share substituted

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.drone_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short DAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Drone-share is not a directional DAL signal (r=-0.03, perm_p=0.73); test volatility instead: gdelt.gkg.drone_share 20d z-score > 1 should raise DAL abs_return over the next 3 sessions (+) [gdelt.gkg.drone_share -> finance.DAL.abs_return] (parent: R2-0163)
